about: The licence audit (SECURITY.md, point 10): everything the game and its tools use, with its licence (SPDX) and where it comes in. tools/licences.js holds each entry to its list: 'ships' (it reaches a player's browser, so its notice is in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt) to the strict list below, word for word point 10's; the rest, tools that only run, to the tools' list in .github/dependency-review-config.yml (any licence the Open Source Initiative approves; GitHub's own services under GitHub's terms). 'loads': the addresses the game fetches it from. Checked 2 November 2026, from each package's own published licence.
